documents.title: Robots access
documents.text: A robots.txt Disallow directive requests that cooperating crawlers avoid matching paths. It does not provide access control or guarantee removal from search results.

documents.title: Canonical hints
documents.text: A rel canonical link identifies a preferred URL among duplicates. Search engines may choose a different canonical because the directive is a hint.

documents.title: Meta description
documents.text: A meta description may be used as a search snippet. A missing description can be flagged by a deterministic page audit, but snippet selection belongs to the search engine.

documents.title: Heading order
documents.text: An H1 introduces the main page topic. Skipped heading levels may make the document outline harder to navigate.

documents.title: JSON-LD validation
documents.text: JSON-LD needs valid JSON syntax. Syntactically valid structured data does not guarantee rich result eligibility.

documents.title: Sitemap scope
documents.text: An XML sitemap lists candidate URLs for discovery. Sitemap inclusion is not a guarantee of indexing.
